question: Following an order of 16 July 2021 , the Supreme Court of India introduced an electronic system named ________, in November 2021, through which its crucial decisions can be communicated electronically to prison authorities and investigating agencies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**FASTER.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Supreme Court of India** introduced an **electronic system **in **November 2021** to communicate its crucial decisions **electronically** to **prison authorities** and investigating agencies.
 
• The system is named **FASTER**, which stands for **"Fast and Secure Transmission of Electronic Records."**
 
• This system is expected to expedite the process of delivering the court's orders to** prison authorities and investigating agencies, **reducing the time taken for **manual processing **and **physical delivery** of the orders.
 
• With this system, the court aims to ensure that the orders are **communicated quickly **and securely to the concerned authorities, thereby **reducing delays** in the justice delivery system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Supreme Court of India** is the** highest court** in the Republic of India and the ultimate **judicial authority.**
 
• The **Chief Justice of India** and up to **33 more justices** make up the Supreme Court.
 
• Through its** original, appellate, and advisory **authorities, it possesses a wide range of powers.
 
• **DY Chandrachud **is the Chief Justice of India at the moment.
